## Description

Deterministic quality gate for canonical SVG deck pages: dual gates (early method sample P01-P05 + final whole-deck), three-severity model (error blocks / warning passes / no auto-fix), bidirectional content-SSOT text-run diff, and SHA-256 fingerprint reports required for export. Use when: running or interpreting svg_check.py on a deck, or deciding whether a deck may export.
